verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for an AI email client, but the evidence shows no user-configurable automation, rule, or scheduled background workflow in Zero. The MCP tools (send, label, bulk archive) are building blocks an external agent could invoke on demand. The founder's mention of auto-categorization is a built-in AI feature, not automations the user sets up to run autonomously.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
